description: This file defines the DelegatorElement class, which models the <delegator> XML element in entity configuration, including parsing attributes and child elements, and providing accessors for configuration data.

classes.name: DelegatorElement
classes.description: A class representing the <delegator> XML element configuration, with attributes for various configuration options and methods to access them.

methods.name: DelegatorElement
methods.description: Constructor that parses an XML Element to initialize the DelegatorElement object, extracting attributes and child <group-map> elements.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the 'name' attribute of the delegator.

methods.name: getEntityEcaEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether entity ECA is enabled.

methods.name: getEntityEcaHandlerClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name for the entity ECA handler.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearEnabled
methods.description: Returns whether distributed cache clear is enabled.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearClassName
methods.description: Returns the class name for cache clearing.

methods.name: getDistributedCacheClearUserLoginId
methods.description: Returns the user login ID for cache clearing.

methods.name: getSequencedIdPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix for sequenced IDs.

methods.name: getKeyEncryptingKey
methods.description: Returns the key used for encryption.

methods.name: getGroupMapList
methods.description: Returns the list of <group-map> child elements.

methods.name: getGroupDataSource
methods.description: Returns the datasource name for a given group name.
